# AGT-ACT-04

**Is code the agent generates or runs executed in a sandbox with no standing credentials?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [AI agent lens](ai-agent.md) 0.1.0 |
| Area | ACT: Actions and blast radius |
| Default severity | blocker |
| Decided by | A tool checks presence; a reviewer judges |
| Applies when | any tool has effect code-execution |
| Reads | `elements.agent.tools.effect`, `elements.trust_zone` |

## Rule

A tool with effect code-execution exists only when its element or connector is in a trust zone named for isolation, and a reviewer confirms the sandbox.

## Sources

- OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications 2026, ASI05 Unexpected Code Execution (`owasp-asi05`)
- AWS Well-Architected Agentic AI Lens (2026) (`aws-agentic-lens`)
